jobs.occupation: Entry IT Specialist, Power BI & Data Engineering - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by turning data into reliable insights and practical solutions for commercial teams?

Do you enjoy combining Power BI development with hands-on support and a growing understanding of Azure data engineering?

Join our Retail Product Team in Commercial IT & Digital and help develop, operate and improve data and reporting solutions used across Arla’s commercial organization. Our portfolio supports areas such as Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

You will work with Power BI solutions built on commercial datasets covering areas such as electronic point-of-sale data, sales, products and customers. You will also build your understanding of the Azure-based data pipelines and data products that provide the foundation for these insights.

How You Will Make An Impact

As our Entry IT Specialist within Retail, your initial focus will be developing, maintaining and supporting Power BI reports and dashboards. Alongside this, you will gradually contribute to selected data engineering activities and strengthen your understanding of the end-to-end data flow from source systems and Azure pipelines to business-facing reporting.

This is a varied and operational role. Your work will shift between development, troubleshooting, incident response, user support and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Architects and other IT colleagues, with support and guidance matched to your experience.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

• Develop, enhance and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models based on business needs.

• Work with Power BI Desktop, Power Query, DAX and SQL to create clear, reliable and user-friendly reporting solutions.

• Support existing Power BI solutions, including investigating incidents, troubleshooting data issues and communicating progress to users and stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, clarify requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.

• Contribute to data quality checks, testing, documentation, deployment and structured handover of new or changed solutions.

• Understand and monitor the upstream data flows that supply Power BI solutions, and help identify whether issues originate in the report, data model or data pipeline.

• Contribute to selected Azure data engineering tasks, such as data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and pipeline maintenance, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, code reviews and continuous improvement activities across the Retail Product Team.

• Help improve operational stability through better monitoring, documentation, reusable solutions and root-cause resolution.

What Will Make You Successful

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. More important than knowing every technology from day one is that you have a solid analytical foundation, enjoy solving real operational problems and are motivated to develop across both business intelligence and data engineering.

We Imagine That You Bring

• A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Practical knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modelling and basic DAX. This may come from work, an internship, studies or personal projects.

• Working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of relational data, data quality and analytical modelling.

• An interest in Azure data platforms and a desire to learn technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake and Databricks.

• Basic programming experience, preferably with Python or PySpark, is an advantage.

• An understanding of ETL/ELT, data pipelines, Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD or automated testing is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• The ability to communicate clearly in English and collaborate with both technical colleagues and business stakeholders.

Most importantly, you are curious, structured and hands-on. You take responsibility for following tasks through, are comfortable asking for support when needed and enjoy a role where priorities can move between planned development and urgent operational needs. You are motivated by learning, but also by making existing solutions work reliably for their users.

What do we offer?

You will join a collaborative Retail Product Team with a broad commercial solution landscape and strong opportunities to learn across reporting, data engineering and product operations. You will gain practical experience with business-critical data and solutions while working closely with experienced specialists, architects and commercial stakeholders.

• A role with Power BI as the initial focus and a clear opportunity to build capabilities in Azure data engineering over time.

• Varied work across development, support, incident handling and continuous improvement rather than a narrow single-technology role.

• Structured onboarding, professional guidance and room to take increasing ownership as your experience grows.

• Exposure to commercial processes and solutions within Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

• An international and collaborative working environment with flexibility and opportunities for professional development.

Would you like to join us?

If you are motivated by combining data, reporting and technology, and want to grow into a versatile specialist who can develop solutions and support them in daily operation, we would like to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Do you want to be at the forefront of managing initiatives that enable next-generation Laser Systems for quantum computers, sensors, and communication systems? Do you thrive on turning complex challenges into structured plans and delivering results that push the boundaries of innovation?

**Then this job as Technical Project Manager for Quantum Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right job for you!

Being in the middle of the second quantum revolution, this is a great time to join us. Our continued success has set us on an exciting growth path—not just in Denmark, but across our global organization. Hamamatsu Photonics, is an inspiring place to work, where we encourage both personal and career development.

You will join a highly skilled and dedicated team of engineers and scientists and play a key role in ensuring successful delivery of projects that develop advanced laser systems and accessories for top-tier quantum technology customers.

**The Role:

**As a member of our Quantum Systems engineering team, you will lead the development, assembly, and testing of custom laser system products and prototypes based on ultra-stable fiber lasers. You interface with sales and support teams to provide updates on product developments and technical advice on customer enquiries as well as assisting with after sales support and repairs/upgrades.

**We are passionate about Quantum Technology! If you are enthusiastic about quantum technologies and computing too, in this position you will:

**

• Lead and manage technical projects from concept to delivery, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met following Hamamatsu Photonics Product and Prototype development processes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams of optical, mechanical and electronics engineers, commercial stake holders, and production specialists to achieve project goals

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customers, providing clear communication and progress updates.

• Develop project plans, risk assessments, and resource allocations to ensure smooth execution.

• Support strategic decision-making by providing insights on project feasibility, technical challenges, and customer requirements.

**More about you:

**As a strong candidate for this position, we hope that you can tick all or most of the following boxes:

• A relevant educational qualification (Master level) is required, preferably gained within a photonics research environment

• Strong background in project management within high-tech or engineering environments (ideally in an industrial context)

• Experience with complex, multi-disciplinary projects, ideally in photonics, optics, or quantum technologies.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders at all levels.

• Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies (e.g. PRINCE or similar).

• A proactive mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

• Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially globally

We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus program.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**What We Value

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Development Representative — Italian Speaking, South Pod EMEAHelp us create qualified enterprise pipeline that protects the world's factory floors

Start date: January 1, 2027

At Secomea, our Sales Development team plays a critical role in creating and developing new business opportunities across manufacturers, machine builders and industrial organizations.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative for our South Pod, with a focus on Italy, you'll work closely with Territory Managers and the wider commercial team to identify the right accounts, engage relevant stakeholders and develop opportunities into qualified enterprise pipeline.

Your primary focus will be supporting our growth across Italy and the Southern European markets.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. We want our SDRs to understand the businesses they target, recognize relevant market and customer signals, and have credible conversations with prospects.

You'll use modern sales technology and AI to make research, preparation and personalization more effective—giving you more time to focus on developing business and engaging customers.

What you'll do

• 
Generate qualified pipeline across named enterprise accounts within the Southern Europe territory

• 
Research and prioritize target accounts based on fit, business signals and relevant triggers

• 
Develop outbound, inbound and partner-sourced opportunities

• 
Engage prospects through calls, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels

• 
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders, including OT, Security, Operations, IT and business leaders

• 
Run initial discovery to understand business challenges, priorities, timing and potential opportunities

• 
Work strategically with Territory Managers on target accounts and territory priorities

• 
Collaborate with Partner Managers, Marketing and Pre-Sales to develop opportunities

• 
Create high-quality Sales Accepted Opportunities and ensure a strong handover to the Territory Manager

• 
Use AI and sales technology to support account research, preparation and relevant outreach

• 
Maintain accurate account, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce

What we're looking for

Commercial curiosity

You're interested in understanding how companies operate, what challenges they're facing and where there may be an opportunity to create value.

You don't just ask, "Who can I book a meeting with?" You want to understand why this company, why this person and why now.

Strong communication

You're comfortable starting conversations with new people, whether that's over the phone, email, LinkedIn or in a meeting.

You can communicate clearly, ask good questions and adapt your approach depending on who you're speaking with.

Fluent, professional-level Italian and English, both written and spoken, is required for this role, as you'll be prospecting, conducting discovery and communicating with senior stakeholders across the Italy and Southern European markets.

Dutch language skills are a strong advantage, but not required.

Account-based thinking

You understand—or want to learn—how enterprise sales differs from high-volume prospecting.

You're comfortable researching accounts, identifying multiple relevant stakeholders and developing different ways into an organization rather than relying on a single contact.

Business acumen

You're interested in learning about manufacturing, industrial operations and cybersecurity and can connect technology to business outcomes such as uptime, productivity, service efficiency, risk and compliance.

AI & digital fluency

You're comfortable using modern technology to work smarter.

Experience with generative AI, sales intelligence or prospecting tools is an advantage, but you don't need to be an AI expert. What's more important is curiosity, good judgment and the willingness to learn how these tools can improve your research and sales effectiveness.

Drive and discipline

You're proactive, resilient and comfortable taking ownership of your territory and pipeline.

At the same time, you understand that enterprise sales requires discipline: following up, keeping CRM data accurate, documenting what you've learned and consistently delivering on commitments.

How we measure success

Success in this role is about creating quality pipeline—not simply generating activity.

You'll be measured on areas including:

• 
Qualified opportunities created

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Qualified meetings booked and held

• 
Quality and conversion of opportunities

• 
Development of target enterprise accounts

• 
Collaboration with Territory Managers and partners

• 
Consistent use of our sales processes and tools

What success looks like at Secomea

Our strongest Enterprise SDRs are account-first, curious and commercially minded.

They research before they reach out. They look for real reasons to engage. They build relationships across an organization rather than relying on one contact. They use technology intelligently, but know that great conversations and human judgment ultimately create opportunities.

Most importantly, they see themselves as business developers—not appointment setters.

If you're excited about developing your enterprise sales career while working at the intersection of industrial technology, cybersecurity and modern sales, we'd like to hear from you.

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

**This position reports to:

**ELSE Cluster Manager North Europe

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**In this role you will work as a power engineer on a range of exciting projects for global clients in a rewarding team environment, developing technical and solution development skills to develop into an industry-recognized consulting engineer. The position would suit a practical and motivated individual who wishes to work in a progressive, innovative electrical consultancy.

This role is ideal for a practical, resourceful, and technically driven engineer who wants to grow into an industry-recognized consulting specialist within a progressive and innovative electrical consultancy environment.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid,

Motivated by continued business growth and increasing customer demand, we are expanding our team and recruiting multiple professionals for this role across the listed countries.

You will be mainly accountable for:

• Providing technical input and leadership on a variety of complex projects.

• Working closely with clients to understand their technical and business requirements and translating them into practical engineering solutions.

• Ensuring project outputs meet client expectations, quality standards, timeframes, and budget requirements.

• Conducting in-depth power systems analysis using widely used methodologies and software tools.

• Preparing detailed technical and non-technical reports, presenting clear recommendations and actionable insights.

• Attending client meetings remotely, building trusted relationships and managing expectations through effective communication and responsiveness.

• Tracking and reporting on project performance and client satisfaction.

• You have experience performing electrical calculations and developing designs in accordance with relevant IEC standards.

• Knowledge of power quality, harmonics and renewable energy integration studies.

• You are interested in solving technical challenges, collaborating with clients and stakeholders, and continuously expanding your knowledge.

• Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• You are comfortable communicating in English and can clearly present technical concepts to a wide range of audiences

**Do you have a proven track record of turning complex operational challenges into tangible results? Are you motivated by getting close to manufacturing operations, analysing performance and working with teams to implement improvements that make a measurable difference?

We are looking for a Project Manager who combines strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the drive, resilience and hands-on approach required to deliver outcomes in complex manufacturing environments.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving difficult problems and seeing your work translate into improved operational performance, this could be your next career move.

**The position

**As a Project Manager, you will work as part of our internal operations and manufacturing consulting team, delivering complex improvement, operational readiness and ramp up projects across our global manufacturing network.

This is not a traditional PMO or project coordination role.

You will be expected to get close to the operation, spend time on the shop floor, understand what is really happening within the production environment and use data and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities for improvement.

More importantly, your responsibility does not end when the solution has been identified. You will work alongside manufacturing teams and stakeholders to turn recommendations into actions and deliver tangible operational outcomes.

Our projects are typically intensive assignments, with project teams substantially dedicated to one project at a time. Assignments will often run for six to twelve months and can sometimes continue for longer.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Taking ownership of project workstreams and operational improvement initiatives from diagnosis through to implementation and delivery.

• Driving operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, helping manufacturing operations achieve stable target performance.

• Working directly with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges and identify bottlenecks, losses and improvement opportunities.

• Analysing operational performance data and developing capacity models, process maps and improvement scenarios.

• Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations, practical implementation roadmaps and measurable actions.

• Driving implementation and following improvements through to tangible operational outcomes.

• Working with production teams to establish sustainable changes in performance and ways of working.

• Collaborating with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain and site leadership.

• Influencing stakeholders and maintaining momentum when implementation is challenging or priorities change.

• Communicating progress, risks, recommendations and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders and project leadership.

The position is based in Lyngby, Denmark, and requires flexibility for up to 50% global travel.

Travel requirements will depend on project assignment and may change throughout a project. The ability and willingness to travel flexibly according to business and project requirements is therefore an essential requirement of the position.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for someone who can demonstrate a proven track record of delivering outcomes, rather than simply participating in projects.

You combine strong intellectual and analytical capability with the practical judgement, resilience and persistence required to turn ideas into results.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a relevant degree in engineering, science, business administration, economics or another relevant discipline.

• Have relevant professional experience within areas such as manufacturing, operational excellence, operations consulting, engineering, supply chain, procurement or complex cross-functional project work.

• Can demonstrate a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering tangible outcomes through projects, operational improvements or complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

• Are comfortable personally analysing operational data and using it to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Can translate analysis into practical recommendations and then follow those recommendations through implementation.

• Are comfortable working hands-on with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams.

• Can operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments where the solution may not initially be obvious.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, collaboration and communication skills.

• Have the resilience and persistence to continue driving change when implementation is difficult or initial solutions do not deliver the expected results.

• Are professionally proficient in English.

• Are able and willing to travel globally for up to 50% of your time according to project requirements.

Relevant experience from operations or management consulting can be particularly valuable, including experience gained within operational practices or projects.

We are also interested in candidates from complex manufacturing environments such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace and FMCG, particularly where you have worked with operational improvement, production ramp-up, manufacturing performance or Lean ways of working.

Pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP and validation experience are advantageous but are not essential.

Experience working within a Lean manufacturing environment can also be beneficial. Formal Lean certification is not required.

Likewise, formal project management qualifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are not a requirement. We place greater emphasis on your demonstrated ability to structure problems, work with people, take ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. • Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. Do you understand pension administration and want to explore how the technology behind it works? Or are you a developer who wants to understand the pension processes your software supports? Join Keylane and help operate and improve Plexus across our private Keylane Cloud and Microsoft Azure.

**Key About Your Role

**You will connect functional knowledge of pension administration with technical application management and a serious interest in automating the work we do. By understanding both the business process, the technical side off the application and the application itself, you will help colleagues and customers identify why issues occur and how to resolve them.

You will:

• Investigate Plexus issues by tracing pension back-office processes through application behaviour, logs and SQL database queries.

• Work with SQL databases and Red Hat Linux environments to diagnose application and data issues, involving database and platform specialists where needed.

• Support Plexus environments hosted on our private Keylane Cloud and on Azure, working with the teams responsible for each platform.

• Coordinate application releases and maintenance, and verify that affected pension processes work correctly after changes.

• Translate functional problems into clear technical findings and explain the business impact of technical issues.

• Use scripts and practical documentation to make recurring support tasks easier and more reliable.

• Take a senior role in complex investigations, share your knowledge and help colleagues develop their approach to problem solving.

**Key About Your Team

**You will work with colleagues supporting Plexus and collaborate with functional specialists, developers and cloud operations teams. Together, you will connect the details of pension administration with the technical work needed to support the application.

**Requirements

**We welcome two professional backgrounds:

• Functional experience with a pension back-office system, combined with a serious interest in technology and a willingness to learn how applications, databases and operating environments work.

• Software development experience, combined with an interest in the business side of pension administration and a willingness to learn how pension processes are supported in Plexus.

Whichever route you bring, you can demonstrate the judgement and ownership expected of a senior colleague. You can work independently, recognize when specialist input is needed and help others move an investigation forward.

You also bring:

• Ideally 5 + years' experience in the field

• A structured approach to investigation, with the ability to connect business symptoms, application behavior and data.

• The ability to explain complex issues clearly in English and work effectively with technical and functional colleagues.

• An interest in hands-on application support and in developing your SQL and Red Hat Linux skills.

• Experience with SQL databases, Linux, scripting or cloud-hosted applications is an advantage. Familiarity with Azure or Plexus is welcome.
